hooks.command: sh -c 'f="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/sidegraph/launch-commit"; c=; [ -f "$f" ] && c=$(head -c 41 "$f" 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *[!0123456789abcdef]*) c= ;; esac; [ "${#c}" -eq 40 ] || c=; u=git+https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph.git@rc/0.14.0-1; [ -n "$c" ] && [ "${u##*@}" = main ] && u=${u%@*}@$c; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && SIDEGRAPH_DIR=.sidegraph SIDEGRAPH_GRAPH=graphify-out/graph.json uvx --from "$u" sidegraph-stop || printf "{}\n"' || printf '{}\n'
hooks.commandWindows: $u='git+https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph.git@rc/0.14.0-1'; $b=$env:XDG_CACHE_HOME; if (-not $b) { $b=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cache' }; $f=Join-Path (Join-Path $b 'sidegraph') 'launch-commit'; $i=Get-Item -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($i -and -not $i.PSIsContainer -and $i.Length -eq 40) { $c=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($f); if ($c -cmatch '^[0123456789abcdef]{40}$' -and $u.EndsWith('@main')) { $u=$u.Substring(0, $u.LastIndexOf('@') + 1) + $c } }; $r=git rev-parse --show-cdup 2>$null; if ($r) { Set-Location -LiteralPath $r }; $env:SIDEGRAPH_DIR='.sidegraph'; $env:SIDEGRAPH_GRAPH='graphify-out/graph.json'; uvx --from $u sidegraph-stop; if (-not $?) { '{}' }
